name: UCSD Extravaganza PBQ 2023
information:
### This is a [PBQ competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDExtravaganzaPBQ2023#33768-what-is-a-pbq-competition). Please see [UCSD Extravaganza 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDExtravaganza2023) for a regular competition the day before.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDExtravaganzaPBQ2023#28383-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
